youtube_description:
Halley Jackson is a senior at Assets High School. She loves to write, draw, and paint. She is planning on attending college in the fall and getting her degree in Forensics/Archaeology with a concentration in bioarchaeology, the study of human remains at archaeological sites. She is passionate about many things and cannot wait to make her mark on the world.

Arwen Uyeoka is a junior at Assets High School.
